<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 600" width="800" height="600">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="sky" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#0b1d4a"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#2d4f9a"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <radialGradient id="wheel" cx="0.5" cy="0.5" r="0.5">
      <stop offset="0.55" stop-color="#555"/>
      <stop offset="0.6" stop-color="#222"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#111"/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Sky and ground -->
  <rect width="800" height="600" fill="url(#sky)"/>
  <circle cx="680" cy="110" r="48" fill="#fff6c8" opacity="0.95"/>
  <ellipse cx="400" cy="560" rx="520" ry="110" fill="#eef4ff"/>
  <rect x="0" y="500" width="800" height="100" fill="#eef4ff"/>

  <!-- Snowflakes -->
  <g fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.85">
    <circle cx="60" cy="80" r="4"/><circle cx="140" cy="160" r="3"/><circle cx="90" cy="300" r="5"/>
    <circle cx="230" cy="60" r="3"/><circle cx="320" cy="130" r="4"/><circle cx="450" cy="60" r="3"/>

    <line x1="30" y1="340" x2="130" y2="340"/>
    <line x1="80" y1="380" x2="160" y2="380"/>
    <line x1="50" y1="450" x2="140" y2="450"/>

    <rect x="534" y="244" width="26" height="16" rx="6" fill="#b3261e"/>
    <rect x="620" y="244" width="26" height="16" rx="6" fill="#b3261e"/>

    <!-- mustache -->
    <path d="M392 222 Q370 212 358 226 Q375 236 392 224 Q409 236 426 226 Q414 212 392 222 Z" fill="#fff"/>
    <!-- nose -->
    <circle cx="392" cy="216" r="8" fill="#e8a088"/>
    <!-- cheeks -->

    <circle cx="418" cy="212" r="7" fill="#f2a5a0" opacity="0.7"/>

    <circle cx="376" cy="198" r="4" fill="#1a1a1a"/>
    <circle cx="408" cy="198" r="4" fill="#1a1a1a"/>
